_readme: Every ONE-OFF item in the game — potions and the six starting-kit pieces. Two sister files generate the rest and both are preferred to authoring by hand here: itemsets.json expands an armour material into one item per plus level, and weapons.json expands a weapon family into one item per MODIFIER per plus level (a Sturdy sword that rewards Strength and a Nimble one that rewards Dexterity, from the same authored steel). Weapons in particular belong there rather than here, because a weapon authored here carries no scaling grades and is therefore strictly worse than a generated one at the same Attack. See each file's own _readme. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. id and displayName are always required. kind is 'Consumable' (default), 'Weapon', or 'Equipment'. Consumables are spent in combat for a one-off effect: effect is 'Heal' (default) or 'RestoreMana', amount defaults to 20, cost defaults to 15. Weapons and Equipment are worn on the [C] Equipment screen and grant their bonus for as long as they are equipped. Weapons: attackBonus is REQUIRED, slot defaults to Weapon1 and may only be a hand; cost defaults to 0 and weapons are never sold in the Store — they only drop as loot. Equipment: slot is REQUIRED (Head, Necklace, Torso, Legs, Shoes, Gloves, Weapon1, Weapon2, or the alias Weapon) and it must grant something, via statBonus (maxHealth/speed/attack/defense) or abilityScoreBonus (strength/dexterity/constitution/wisdom/intelligence/charisma) or both. A Weapon1 item also fits Weapon2, so dual-wielding needs no second entry. Mixing field sets — a Weapon with an amount, a Consumable with an attackBonus, Equipment using attackBonus instead of statBonus.attack — is rejected rather than silently ignored. Set startingStock to true to put one in a brand new profile's stash; granted once at profile creation, never on load, so it is a starting kit and not an income. Weapon drops are tiered automatically by attackBonus: see FightController.RollWeaponDrop — Elite rooms drop from the weaker half of the list, Boss rooms from the stronger half, so no dropTier field is needed here.
